name: Ticket triage into a strict JSON object

messages.content: You triage incoming support tickets for a SaaS analytics product. Reply with ONLY a JSON object with exactly these keys: "category" (one of: billing, bug, feature_request, account, other), "priority" (one of: low, medium, high) and "summary" (one sentence). No markdown, no code fences, no text outside the object.
Since this morning every export I run from the Reports page downloads an empty CSV file. We have a board meeting tomorrow and need these numbers. Account: Fabrikam Ltd, plan: Business.
